description: This PHP source file defines the ApplicantController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It handles applicant submissions, including processing uploaded resumes, validating input parameters, creating Candidate and associated entities, and managing transactions related to candidate applications for specific vacancies.

classes.name: ApplicantController
classes.description: Controller class handling applicant submissions and interactions within the recruitment plugin of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming applicant requests, processes resume uploads, validates parameters, manages database transactions, and redirects after submission.

methods.name: validateParameters
methods.description: Validates request parameters and uploaded attachment against predefined rules, including vacancy status checks.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Creates and saves Candidate, CandidateVacancy, CandidateHistory, and CandidateAttachment entities within a transaction.

methods.name: setApplicant
methods.description: Populates a Candidate entity with data from the request.

methods.name: setApplicantVacancy
methods.description: Sets data for CandidateVacancy entity linked to the applicant and vacancy.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Returns an instance of ValidationDecorator, instantiated lazily.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request parameters.

methods.name: setCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Associates uploaded resume data with a CandidateAttachment entity.
